paragraphs: Fermi Inc's stock price is 2.61, representing a 26.7 percent increase from the prior close, although it has decreased by 17.41 percent over a window of 23 sessions. The last price quote is as of November 13, 2026.

The recent news is driven by Amazon being named as Fermi's 600 MW customer for Project Matador, with a $200 million prepayment. This news has contributed to Fermi's stock price increase. Other news includes Fermi's Q3 2026 earnings call and the company being one of the stocks defying tech market turmoil.

There have been various SEC filings, including a Form 144 notice of proposed sale and a Form 10-Q filing disclosing the company's Q3 2026 financial and operational updates. Insider activity includes an insider transaction report filed on November 6, 2026, and notices of proposed sales filed on November 12 and November 5, 2026.
